notes.title: Cartels January 16th Playtest
notes.notes: This Sunday, January 16th, 2022, we'll be hosting a playtest to test some new features we've added in this stage of development. If you're interested in joining the playtest, please sign up for a key in [url=https://discord.gg/9NutT9XuSB]Our Discord Server[/url] and fill out the sign-up form.

notes.title: Cartels 0.0.31.1 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
- Fixed bad occlusion culling data on Jungle
- Fixed bushes not rendering on Jungle
- Fixed Jungle A building being too far off the ground
- Fixed end game message on Trench displaying the opposite of the actual game state

notes.title: Cartels 0.0.31.0 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
- Fixed inability to join teams after someone takes damage
- Fixed inconsistent damage values
- Updated third person animations
- Updated Jungle spawns for objectives B and C
- Adjusted damage falloffs for most weapons
- Fixed m870 empty reload always cancelling after the first round
- Updated server browser slightly
- World space UI now hides when aiming at it
- Adjusted Camp_ARCADE weapon spawns

notes.title: Cartels 0.0.30.0 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
- Fixed input related crash related to locals using commas instead of decimals because they are backwards
- Fixed some guns not doing damage
- Fixed shotguns not hitting more than 1-2 pellets sometimes
- Fixed training range weapons being affected by grenades
- Added M870 Flechette
- Made ping display properly
- Fixed error when shooting suppression at non-players
- Updated 3p animation set
- Updated game logo

notes.title: Cartels 0.0.29.1 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]

- Updated third person muzzle flashes
- Fixed cartel player sets being used for the coalition

- Fixed an error when first spawning

notes.title: Cartels 0.0.29.0 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]

- Added steam launch param "inputdebug"
- Bullets now have travel time and drop, bullet tracers
- Added bots. Use the "addbots" command as an admin to spawn them
- Added new character variants for cartel + coalition
- Fixed some issues with Trench
- Fixed not being able to enter the corner of the Jungle A building
- Fixed many cursor locking issues
- Updated Jungle
- Fixed grenades not doing damage
- A spawn timer is now shown in the loadout editor
- The UI update is triggered now when spotting
- Increased machine gun ADS speeds by about 20%
- Updated animator transitions in first person
- Added fall damage
- Added damage tagging (slowed movement after being hit)
- Fixed gun holster and draw timings being out of sync with the animations
- Updated muzzle flashes for most guns
- Subsonic weapons no longer produce a crack when suppressing an enemy
- Optimized some third person animator parameters
